caption: The drawing shows a single object resembling a skirt or protective garment, depicted in muted shades of tan and brown. It is shaped like a truncated cone, wider at the bottom and narrower at the top, with a small split at the upper edge. The upper half features a diamond-shaped quilted pattern, while the lower half displays a series of semicircular, fan-like motifs that overlap in a regular and orderly manner. The rim at the top is rendered in a slightly different brown color and shows a glimpse of its inner lining, which appears to be a pale color with a delicate, dark floral or vine-like design. The background is a solid, light beige color with no other objects or markings except for a signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Quilted Petticoat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
